lead: The options mix active and passive forms of one verb: has postponed, has been postponed, is postponing. Whether the subject does the action or receives it decides.
選項同時有主動和被動，例如 has postponed、has been postponed、is postponing。看主詞是做動作還是承受動作。
steps: Find the subject. Does it do the action or receive it?
找出主詞，它是做動作的一方，還是承受動作的一方。
Look at what follows the blank. An object right after the verb usually means active.
看空格後面。動詞後面直接接受詞，通常是主動。
Check the verb itself. Some verbs have no passive at all.
檢查動詞本身，有些動詞根本沒有被動。

head: An object follows: active
後面有受詞：主動
body: A transitive verb followed by its object is usually active. The subject is the one doing the action.
及物動詞後面接受詞時，通常用主動，主詞是做動作的一方。
ex: The committee has postponed the meeting until further notice.
委員會已將會議延期，另行通知。
Ms. Ito signed the contract on Friday.
伊藤女士在星期五簽了合約。

head: No object, subject receives: passive
沒有受詞，主詞承受動作：被動
body: When the subject receives the action and no object follows, use be + past participle. The tense is carried by be: has been, will be, is being.
主詞承受動作、後面沒有受詞時，用 be + p.p.。時態由 be 表現：has been、will be、is being。
ex: The meeting has been postponed until further notice.
會議延期，另行通知。
The results will be announced at the end of the month.
結果將在月底公布。
The warehouse is being renovated, so deliveries may be delayed.
倉庫正在整修，所以送貨可能延遲。

head: Verbs with no passive
沒有被動的動詞
body: Arise, occur, happen, rise, remain, appear, exist, take place and consist of are intransitive. They never take be + past participle.
arise、occur、happen、rise、remain、appear、exist、take place、consist of 是不及物動詞，不能用 be + p.p.。
ex: A problem occurred during the installation.
安裝過程中發生了一個問題。
Several issues arose during the negotiations.
談判過程中出現了幾個問題。
The conference will take place in Dublin in March.
研討會將於三月在都柏林舉行。

head: Raise and rise, lay and lie
raise 與 rise、lay 與 lie
body: Raise and lay need an object. Rise and lie do not, and they have no passive. In an active sentence with no object, rise is the verb that fits.
raise、lay 後面要有受詞；rise、lie 不需要受詞，也沒有被動。主動句後面沒有受詞時，選 rise。
ex: Prices rose sharply in May.
五月價格急遽上漲。
The company raised its prices in May.
公司在五月調漲了價格。

head: Two objects: a noun can follow a passive
兩個受詞：被動後面仍可接名詞
body: Give, offer, send, award and grant take two objects. In the passive one object is left behind, so a noun can follow the verb. A noun after a passive verb is not always wrong.
give、offer、send、award、grant 有兩個受詞，改成被動後還剩一個，所以被動動詞後面接名詞不一定錯。
ex: Ms. Rivera was offered the position of regional manager.
Rivera 女士獲得了區域經理的職位。
Employees will be given two additional days off.
員工將多獲得兩天假。

head: Passive + to + verb
被動 + to + 原形動詞
body: Be required to, asked to, expected to, encouraged to, allowed to and scheduled to are standard patterns in notices and announcements.
be required to、asked to、expected to、encouraged to、allowed to、scheduled to 是公告和通知裡的標準句型。
ex: All visitors are required to sign in at the front desk.
所有訪客都必須在櫃台登記。
The audit is scheduled to begin on Monday.
稽核預定星期一開始。

head: Passive in English, active in Chinese
英文是被動，中文常翻成主動
body: Be located in, be based in and be scheduled for are passive in form. Chinese says them actively: 位於, 總部設在, 預定。
be located in、be based in、be scheduled for 形式上是被動，中文卻常說成主動：位於、總部設在、預定。
ex: Our head office is located in Taipei.
我們的總公司位於台北。
The company is based in Osaka.
這家公司總部設在大阪。

pairs.wrong: Prices were risen sharply in May.
why: Rise has no passive. To say that someone increased them, use raise: Prices were raised.
rise 沒有被動。要表達「被調漲」，改用 raise：Prices were raised。

pairs.right: An error occurred during the update.
pairs.wrong: An error was occurred during the update.
why: Occur is intransitive, so it cannot take be + past participle.
occur 是不及物動詞，不能用被動。

pairs.right: Mr. Chen was awarded a bonus.
why: Here Mr. Chen is the one who receives the bonus, so the verb is passive. Active awarded would mean he gave it to someone. A bonus is the object left over after the passive.
這裡陳先生是得到獎金的人，所以要用被動。主動的 awarded 會變成他頒發獎金給別人。a bonus 是被動後剩下的那個受詞。

traps: A thing as the subject does not always mean passive. The new policy affects all staff is active. Decide by whether an object follows.
主詞是事物，不代表就要用被動。The new policy affects all staff 是主動。要看後面有沒有受詞。
Check the tense inside the passive. Is being renovated is happening now, has been renovated is finished, will be renovated is planned.
被動裡的時態也要看。is being renovated 是正在進行，has been renovated 是已完成，will be renovated 是預計。
A by phrase naming who did it points to the passive: reviewed by the director. A by phrase with a time, such as by Friday, says nothing about voice.
by 加上做動作的人，指向被動：reviewed by the director。by 加時間（by Friday）則看不出主動或被動。
